node: Travel distribution middleware, property connectivity, payments routing, loyalty infrastructure, and fraud prevention
summary: Layer 1B expands the underfollowed lane for the travel distribution/payments/fraud infrastructure node. Obvious consumer-facing reference anchors are OTAs, airlines, hotel chains, and card networks, but this pass prioritizes US-listed infrastructure vendors that sit one or two steps away from the traveler: GDS/distribution rails, hotel property systems, cross-border vertical payments, and fraud/chargeback decisioning. The strongest direct fits in this pass are Sabre for travel distribution rails and Agilysys for hospitality property/connectivity software. Flywire and Riskified are more second-order: they benefit if travel merchants, schools/travel programs, ticketing, and cross-border bookings require more specialized payments and fraud orchestration.
